title: reseda paui
intro: Reseda paui, commonly known as Moroccan rue, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Reseda paui include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as calming the nervous system, relieving digestive issues, and promoting wound healing. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat respiratory problems and skin conditions, showcasing its versatility in traditional medicine.
